summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated payload referencing credential paths
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into the OS tmpdir, unzips it, chmods it executable, and invokes the sibling file math_init.js under that freshly downloaded alternate runtime via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, string-array-plus-rotation obfuscated script (marker `// @bun @bun-cjs`) that no other file in the package references; its embedded string table decodes fragments including `.aws` (multiple occurrences) and the GitHub server-token prefix `ghs_`. The declared purpose of the package (an OREST micro-UI publisher CLI) does not require the Bun runtime. On every `npm install` the obfuscated payload executes before any user action, with cleartext substrings consistent with reading AWS and GitHub credentials from the installer's environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
